name: Barbell Behind-the-Neck Press
steps: Stand tall with a barbell resting lightly across your upper traps behind your neck and grasp it with a wide overhand grip.
Brace your abs and glutes firmly while stacking your wrists directly over your elbows.
Press the bar smoothly straight overhead until your arms extend without locking violently.
Lower the bar slowly behind your head to ear level or lightly to your upper traps within comfortable shoulder range.
tips: Keep your neck tall and neutral rather than pushing your head forward as the bar passes.
Limit the descent to the range you can control comfortably without pushing your head forward.
